units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:7">Gen. R. s. 17</cite> <he>א׳ של כסף</he> an ounce of silver.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:2">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᶜ</cite> top there is not a generation in which there is not (to be atoned for through suffering) <he>אונקי אחת וכ׳</he> (read <he>אונקיא אחת</he>) a particle of the sin of the calf-worship.
